race.comment: MELDUBIOUS (6) was a strong winner two back at Eagle Farm and followed it up with a close finish here last time. Has been kept fresh with a month between runs and will prove hard to beat if he holds his form. Can't fault LISTEN JANI (15)'s efforts as she shoots for four straight but she will need to raise the bar again. Will be in this for a long way from the cosy draw. HEADHUNTER (18) has been savaging the line throughout this campaign. Peaking now and if the pace is genuine he can round them up. RIMBAUD (4) was nabbed on the line here at the midweeks last month when leading them into the lane. Should bounce straight the front from his inside draw and give them something to catch again. STARMAN (14) has improved with each run this campaign. Fought on bravely into the placings after being sent forward at Eagle Farm. Should be nearing his peak now but is drawn sticky.
